name: M. G. Hall
role: Assistant superintendent of the Northern Pacific Express Co.
bio: M. G. Hall was assistant superintendent of the Northern Pacific Express Co. and passed through Medora on the railroad in 1884. In November 1885 he resigned after a long time in that post to take the company's agency at St. Paul.

moments.label: Arrived as N. P. Express assistant superintendent

mentions: There were two sections of No. 1 this morning, both very heavy trains. The first section had eleven coaches.
